import re
d=open('/tmp/p-main.js').read()
# 项目行 fnE 的 header 构造：找 fnF 调用点，看 header 里有没有 disclosure/chevron
i=d.find('function fnE(')
seg=d[i:i+16000]
print('=== fnE 内 chevron/disclosure/fnG 出现 ===')
for kw in ['icon-disclosure','fnG','chevron','Chevron','caret']:
    hits=[m.start() for m in re.finditer(re.escape(kw), seg)]
    print(kw,'->',len(hits),'hits', hits[:5])
print()
j=seg.find('(0,n\$.jsx)(fnF,{')
print('=== fnF 调用点（header 组成）===')
print(repr(seg[j:j+700]))
"
